docs.overviewSummary: What PiperHub is and how the documentation is organized.
docs.overviewCopy: PiperHub indexes open voice models for Piper, a fast, local neural text-to-speech engine. These guides cover the full path: preparing recordings in LJSpeech format, training on a free Kaggle GPU, then running the voice from the command line, Python, Home Assistant or Node.js.
docs.calloutCopy: Every model in the catalog can be tried directly in the browser. Synthesis runs on your device; no audio or text is sent to a server.
